authority_basis: Independent generic observable review: identified recorded approval is a positive boundary; an approver name alone is not a record. Preserve the distinction without declaring every human approval unobservable.

cases.rationale: The named JSON artifact and explicit entry/decision predicate supply inspectable approval evidence. The statement preserves one quoted gate; the role labels do not rely on any active project fact.

anchor.quote: Only start deployment if approvals.json contains a release-lead entry with decision approved.
anchor.statement: Deployment may start only when approvals.json contains a release-lead entry whose decision is approved.

cases.rationale: An identified Markdown checklist records the human signature, so approval is observable without inferring an unstated record. One timing condition is faithfully formalized and self-contained.

anchor.quote: Wait to publish until the release lead has signed release-checklist.md.
anchor.statement: Publishing must wait until release-checklist.md records the release lead's signature.
